processEnvironment.value: VK_LOADER_LAYERS_DISABLE=~implicit~, set for llama-server's process only. Without it, this build crashed while loading the tensors of any model on this machine, in every load mode and with no layer offloaded, and it loaded with every implicit Vulkan layer disabled. Those layers belong to other applications installed on the machine, overlays among them; which one crashed it was not narrowed down
processEnvironment.source: llama-server's log and exit code (a segmentation fault right after load_tensors), with and without the variable

notUsed.value: The same release's ROCm build, llama-b10662-bin-win-rocm-7.14-x64.zip, which would have matched the first report's backend: its ggml-hip.dll imports hipblas.dll, which the archive does not carry and this machine does not have, and llama-server --list-devices listed no device. The Vulkan build of the latest release, b11739, crashed the same way as b10662's while the implicit layers were enabled
